written: After two rounds of review and a rebase on Tuesday, the tests ran green twice in a row. So ABC-12 is merged.
The vendor sent the new certificate on Monday, and Mira checked it on the staging host this morning. The renewal for QRS-40 is done.
Three of the five shards moved last night, and the last two moved an hour ago without errors. In short, the migration in TUV-7 is finished.
Odette asked for one more test, and the build had to run again because of a flaky check. That is why PR 88 is still open.
The design doc lists two options for the schema, and the team met twice to compare them. Nobody has decided yet, so XYZ-3 is blocked.
The benchmark ran twelve times on the new hardware, and the numbers stayed close on each run. The median latency for LMN-21 is now 180 ms.
First the cache was turned on, and then the old cron job was removed. The bill was checked at the end of the month. The cost of DEF-9 went down by half.
I tried the steps in the issue on two laptops and on the test server. I could not reproduce the bug in GHI-55.
The release notes were written on Friday, the tag was pushed this morning, and the deploy finished at noon. Version 2.14 of JKL-6 is live.
Rafael wanted the retention question settled first, and he answered the ask an hour ago with 90 days. So the work on MNO-17 can start now.
